prompt: I have this API endpoint: GET /api/v1/getUserById?id=123 and POST /api/v1/createNewUser. Review it and suggest improvements following best practices.

assertions.name: identifies_verb_in_url
assertions.description: Identifies verbs in URL as anti-pattern (getUserById should be noun)

assertions.name: suggests_path_param
assertions.description: Suggests path parameter over query param for resource ID (/users/{id})

assertions.name: identifies_camelcase
assertions.description: Identifies camelCase URLs as anti-pattern (should be lowercase-hyphen)

assertions.name: consistent_naming
assertions.description: Points out inconsistent naming between endpoints
